summary: Migration is functionally faithful (builds, runs, all 3 scenarios render, Initialize Camera actuates). The only shortfall is an automation-exposure gap: interactive controls carry only x:Name, no AutomationProperties.AutomationId, so the 'Video Settings' ComboBox is invisible to UIA structural matching and to assistive tech. This recurs on any migrated control whose identity is only x:Name.
